source: Public Ubisoft Rainbow Six esports website: pageData from __NEXT_DATA__
scope: 2026/27 season through snapshot; regional Kickoff, Stage 1, Stage 2, Salt Lake City Major, EWC. SI2026 is excluded because it belongs to season2025/26.
tier1_rule: Regional league participation, not world ranking. All regional participants are retained, including promoted and unsigned teams; international participants are retained as well.
team_identity: Ubisoft team.id; organization names are observations, not stable primary keys. Different team IDs are never merged automatically.
match_grain: One series, including BO1 and BO3.
map_grain: One played game inside a series; completed games only.
round_grain: One physical round, unique round_id. Attacker, defender and winner IDs are preserved.
team_round_grain: Two perspectives per physical round, unique (round_id, team_id). Do not count rows in this table as physical rounds.
player_stats_grain: Player/team/map, not player/round. All numeric values and nulls from the source are preserved.
null_policy: An unavailable value stays null; zero is only preserved when supplied by the source. No estimates fill missing site, first kill or plant events.
raw_codes: status_code, result_code, win_method_code, source_data_validity and map-selection codes remain source integers. Finished status=3 was verified against a public match page. Other enums are not guessed.
time: UTC ISO8601 source timestamps; fetched_at_utc identifies the retrieval, not the match date.

metrics.win_rate: won observed rounds / observed rounds in the selected context
metrics.overtime_round_win_rate: won rounds with round_number>12 / observed rounds with round_number>12. Source isOvertime is unreliable and retained separately as source_is_overtime.
metrics.last_n_maps: Select distinct played game_ids ordered by match date and map index before filtering rounds.
metrics.first_kill_conversion: Unavailable: map-level opening kills cannot establish round-level conversion.
metrics.site_win_rate: Unavailable: bombsite not present in observed public round payload.

coverage: Discovery exhausts all phase pages in the discovered competitions. This is coverage of the public source, not proof that the organizer recorded every real-world match/event correctly.
quality: Raw payloads are retained alongside issues. Check quality_report.json and collection_status.json before trusting metrics or making a completeness claim.
